programme: ShotSight Virtual Shooter — Learn to Shoot
governing_rule: ORACLE KNOWS. SHOOTER PERCEIVES, BELIEVES, ACTS, REMEMBERS AND LEARNS.
l2_planning_status: WHOLE_PRESENTATION_CONTEXT_AND_RUNWAY_VALUE_GREEN; ACTUAL SHOT PLAN STILL MUST MIGRATE OFF LOCAL_0.12S_HORIZON_BEFORE_MOTOR_STAGE

l0_reference.interpretation: Engineering ceiling and weak lower baseline only; not human performance or real break probability.

l1_reference.interpretation: L1 architecture is complete; poor-view ambiguity is real and later stages must price observation time against shooting opportunity.

l2_local_plan_reference.interpretation: Perception-sensitive and method-distinct, but invalid as whole-presentation planning because coordinates are tied to a local 0.12 s belief horizon.

l2_presentation_context_runway.interpretation: Ellis can retain cumulative observed presentation progress separately from a short working belief window and trade calibration-learned expected information value against diminishing shooter-visible pre-break runway without oracle future/intercept data. This is not shooting success.

active_hypotheses: First-clear-sight epoch 0.20 s, expected presentation duration 0.95 s, demonstrated angular span 0.62 rad, break-window progress 0.70–0.90 and runway penalty are provisional SHOTSIGHT_HYPOTHESIS values, not human prescriptions.
Calibration labels may estimate the expected value of additional observation; held-out labels/oracle actions remain unavailable at runtime.
Pre-break runway should price information-seeking more strongly than time remaining to the far edge of a break window; this must later be tested against motor/shot outcomes and Sense/video evidence.
negative_findings: Inherited canonical flat-crosser exposes exact intercept/physical lead and remains hidden oracle/reference truth only.
Current target engine and centreline evaluator are engineering proxies, not certified realistic clay aerodynamics, shot cloud or breakability.
Base L1 stable-crosser uncertainty was under-dispersed and required held-out calibration; simple stable crossers are an easy task.
Poor 220 ms acquisition materially collapses crosser-versus-quarterer discrimination; uncertainty must be allowed to change behaviour.
Gravity-only looper recognition is too easy and is not real-looper validation.
An unconstrained L1 wait policy degenerated into waiting on every target; selectivity/opportunity cost is a required behavioural gate.
L2 source-informed plans score lower than blank-slate on the internal structure proxy; that proxy is bookkeeping only and cannot be a success objective.
The first L2 local planner delayed the break toward 0.97 under poor perception and maps the whole target onto only 0.12 s; it must not feed motors in this form.
The first whole-presentation context incorrectly used a rolling 220 ms history and therefore forgot how much target travel had already passed; cumulative visible presentation memory fixed this.

The first runway policy used confidence gain as information value and selected 50 ms on every early target, giving 18.75% held-out accuracy versus 43.125% for fixed 100 ms. Confidence gain was rejected as a misleading surrogate and replaced with calibration Brier-loss improvement.
The current value-of-information calibration is crosser-only because the existential experiment begins with crossers; mixed-family value models remain future validation.
No Brett Winstanley hold/pickup/break-point claim is promoted without a recovered primary source.
next_action: Integrate SHOOTER_VISIBLE_PRESENTATION_CONTEXT_V1 into the actual source-informed and blank-slate pickup/hold/connection/break planner so plan coordinates live on the whole shooter-visible presentation rather than the 0.12 s prediction horizon. On held-out crossers, verify that consumed runway constrains connection/break planning and that poor perception can invoke the value-of-information policy without simply driving break points to the far end. Preserve method topology and source evidence classes. Do not advance to motor/trigger learning until this presentation-level planner is green, and do not expose oracle intercept, exact lead, range or hidden future trajectory.
